en: I am Kiawe, captain of this volcano's trial. You are early. Walk Route 8 first, and come back when it is done.
Welcome to Wela Volcano Park! I am Kiawe, and this crater is my trial.
My Pokémon and I dance for the volcano. Two of its Pokémon will join in. Battle them, and the totem will answer!
Two dancers first, a Salandit and a Cubone. Then the totem itself!
The Salandit hissed and leapt into the dance!
The Cubone twirled its bone and leapt into the dance!
A towering Marowak strode out of the smoke, its bone blazing at both ends!
...Magnificent. The volcano itself must be cheering. You have passed my trial!
This is the Firium Z. With it, a Fire-type move becomes a Z-Move. Burn bright.
Mallow's trial is in the Lush Jungle, west off Route 8. Tell her she still owes me lunch.
Smoke curls from the crater's far side... The dancers come first.
A Salazzle as big as a boulder slinks out of the smoke at the crater's edge!
